summary.text: Margaret Drye is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives who has represented Sullivan 7 since December 2022 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She lives in Plainfield and works as a volunteer EMT.

paragraphs.text: Margaret Drye lives in Plainfield, New Hampshire, and earned a bachelor's degree in mathematics from Mount Holyoke College in 1980.
Her career experience includes working as a volunteer EMT and home-schooling her children.
She served as a member and chairman of the Plainfield Finance Committee and as clerk of the Plainfield Village Water District.
Drye succeeded Judy Aron (R) and assumed office on December 7, 2022.
She advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.
